description: Source code implementing packed-refs backend for Git, including snapshot management, reference reading, iteration, locking, and filesystem consistency checks.

classes.name: snapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the packed-refs file, including its contents, state, and reference counting.

classes.name: packed_ref_store
classes.description: Represents the packed-refs reference store, including file path, snapshot, lock, and flags.

classes.description: Interface for reference storage, implemented by packed_ref_store.

classes.description: Iterator over references in the packed-refs snapshot.
